name: banking77_v6
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent best describes what the customer is asking about? Pick exactly one intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a card they have received: how to activate it, activation not working, card needs activating.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open or use an account; whether children/teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or Android Pay with the account; topping up via Apple/Google Pay or it not working.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs/cash machines accept the card, where the nearest ATM is, whether the card works at ATMs in general.

automatic_top_up.meaning: Anything about the auto top-up feature: setting it up, how it works, its limits or amounts, it not working, turning it off.
examples: What, if any, is the limit  for auto top-up?

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.meaning: Money moved into this account by bank transfer (e.g. from their other bank or UK account) has not shown up in the balance yet; asking to check whether the money has reached their account.
examples: Why is it taking so long to update my balance transfer?
How long does a transfer from the UK account usually take? After completing the transfer it is not showing up. I need to know that everything I actually went okay.
Can you check if my money has reached my account since it is not showing up yet?

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.meaning: Money they deposited (a cheque or cash deposit; 'I deposited money') is not showing in the balance yet, or a cheque is slow to clear.
examples: I recently deposited some money into my account, but it still isn't showing up. What's going on?

criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee, or a transfer to a beneficiary is not allowed or rejected for that beneficiary.

cancel_transfer.meaning: Wants to cancel, stop or undo a transfer/payment they just made (e.g. sent by mistake to the wrong account).
examples: I want to take back my transaction

criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement/renewal card before expiry.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, whether shops/merchants accept it, card not accepted by a merchant.
criteria.card_arrival: An ordered physical card has not arrived / not been delivered yet and they want help, tracking, or to report it missing (without asking for an expected time).

card_delivery_estimate.meaning: How long card delivery takes, when they can expect their ordered card (asking for a time or date), express/fast-tracked delivery, delivery to a country/address.
examples: I ordered my card a couple weeks ago and haven't received it yet. When can I expect it?
How will I get my card?

criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the app/account, re-linking a found card, where in the app to link a card.
criteria.card_not_working: Their card does not work / stopped working / won't work in general, e.g. it didn't work at a shop or in several places (not specifically contactless, ATM or a virtual card).

card_payment_fee_charged.meaning: Was charged a fee for paying with the card (a card purchase/payment incurred an extra fee).
examples: Let me know when you charge extra for payments please. I just checked the app earlier when I saw that there was an additional fee on one of the payments that I wasn't warned about before.

card_payment_not_recognised.meaning: A card payment/purchase on the statement they did not make or don't recognise.
examples: I didn't make a payment that shows in my app.

card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.meaning: A card payment in a foreign currency got a wrong or bad exchange rate.
examples: There's an error with the rate that is charged.

criteria.card_swallowed: The ATM/cash machine kept, ate or swallowed the card (the message mentions the machine/ATM).
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Was charged a fee when getting/withdrawing cash (at an ATM), or asks about cash withdrawal fees.

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.meaning: A cash withdrawal on the account they did not make or don't recognise; the app shows cash taken out that they did not receive.
examples: My app is showing a cash balance that I did not receive.
Hi, It's urgent, please freeze my card. As someone has withdrawn money using my card in odd remote town. Since i have not done this withdrawal. Do it fast.

criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset an existing card PIN, where (which ATMs) they can change their PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Card details were compromised, hacked or skimmed; someone else is using the card or its details while they still have the card.

country_support.meaning: Which countries the service/cards are available or supported in; using the account when living in or moving to another country.
examples: Can I get support?

declined_card_payment.meaning: A specific card payment/purchase was declined, rejected or not accepted.
examples: My card was not accepted in a shop

declined_cash_withdrawal.meaning: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined; the ATM refused to give cash.
examples: My card wont work at an ATM

criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected by the bank / they're told the transfer isn't possible.

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.meaning: A direct debit payment they don't recognise or didn't set up; a mistaken charge on their debit / direct debit statement.
examples: I think I was charged by mistake on my debit statement.

disposable_card_limits.meaning: Limits of disposable virtual cards: how many disposable cards they can make or use (e.g. per day), how many times or how much each can be used, restrictions.
examples: I must make several disposable cards every day.

criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal or account details: name, address, phone, email, account information.

exchange_charge.meaning: Fees or charges for exchanging currency; what the exchange fee is.
examples: If I exchange currency frequently, can I get a discounted rate?

criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, how rates are set, current rate between currencies.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange or convert money between currencies in the app; whether they can exchange currency X for Y.

extra_charge_on_statement.meaning: An unexpected extra small fee/charge appearing on the statement (e.g. extra £1), asking why they were charged.
examples: I see a charge of 1L I do not recognize on my statement

criteria.failed_transfer: A bank transfer (sending money to an account) failed, did not go through, or bounced back. Not for card payments or purchases that were returned (that is reverted_card_payment?).
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which (fiat) currencies the account can hold, receive or pay in; whether a currency is supported.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable (single-use) virtual card, whether the feature is available to them.

get_physical_card.meaning: Getting the physical (plastic) card when they have a virtual one or none; whether they have, or where to find, the PIN of their card (not changing an existing PIN).
examples: Do I have a card PIN?

criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/extra/spare card, e.g. for a family member, how many cards they can have.

getting_virtual_card.meaning: How to get a (non-disposable) virtual card, cost of a virtual card, or an ordered virtual card not received/not showing yet.
examples: I haven't received my virtual card.

lost_or_stolen_card.meaning: Card was lost, misplaced or stolen; getting the card back / retrieving it; what to do, block it.
examples: Can you help me retrieve my card?

criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone was lost or stolen; access to the account/app without the phone.

order_physical_card.meaning: Ordering a new physical card: how to order, cost, choosing delivery, ordering another card.
examples: Is payment required to get a card of my own?

criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password, resetting the passcode, locked out of the app.

pending_card_payment.meaning: A card payment or purchase they made is still pending or hasn't gone through yet; how long until it clears.
examples: I have a payment that has not gone through yet

pending_cash_withdrawal.meaning: A cash withdrawal is shown as pending / still in progress, they did not get the money from the withdrawal, or it hasn't come out of the account yet.
examples: I didn't receive my money earlier and it says the transaction is still in progress. Can you fix it?

criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up (adding money to the account; sometimes misspelled) is pending, not gone through yet or taking a long time to complete.

pending_transfer.meaning: A bank transfer (incoming or outgoing) is still pending / in progress / not cleared yet, e.g. money transferred to them that they can't see yet.
examples: How much longer do I have to wait until my transaction is complete? I transferred money to another country many hours ago and the transaction is still pending.
Money was transferred to me and I am unable to see it

criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked or the card/account is locked after entering the wrong PIN too many times.

receiving_money.meaning: How to receive money/payments into the account, e.g. salary or from a friend; incoming payments.
examples: Do I need to add my salary?
Can my friend send me money if it is not in US dollars?

criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the merchant already issued/promised has not appeared in the account yet.

request_refund.meaning: Wants a refund or to cancel a purchase they no longer want; return policy; how to request a refund or how long getting a refund takes.
examples: I no longer want this can i cancel my purchase?
How long does it take to get a refund on something I bought?

reverted_card_payment?.meaning: A payment (card payment/purchase) was reverted, returned or cancelled and the money came back to the account; why a payment was reversed or returned.
examples: I made a payment but it was returned.
I just found out from the seller that my money didn't go through. I checked my account and it was deducted at first but now it's back in my account. Can you  please fix this for me quickly?

criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, issuing countries) can be used to top up, which cards and currencies are supported.
criteria.terminate_account: Closing, deleting or terminating the account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee or charge specifically for topping up by bank transfer (the message mentions a bank transfer top-up).

top_up_by_card_charge.meaning: Fee or charge for topping up / adding money with a card, including general questions about a fee for adding money (e.g. in another currency).
examples: Do you charge a fee for adding money in USD?

criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: How to top up / add money to the account using cash or a cheque (depositing cash or cheques).

top_up_failed.meaning: A top-up failed, did not work, was declined, or they are not sure it went through.
examples: I can't access my money. Is it because somethings wrong with the top-up? I set it up correctly.
I'm not sure if my pop-up went through.

criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on (manual) top-ups: maximum/minimum amount, how much or how often they can top up. Questions about auto top-up limits are automatic_top_up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted/cancelled and the money returned or disappeared after topping up.

topping_up_by_card.meaning: How to top up using a debit/credit card; card top-up process; whether other people can top up their account; money missing after a card top-up.
examples: Can other people top up my account?

criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment/transaction was charged twice (duplicate charge).

transfer_fee_charged.meaning: Was charged a fee for a transfer, transfer fees, whether they will get extra charges/fees, or unexpected fees after using the account abroad/overseas.
examples: I have used this account overseas recently. Has there been an increase in fees that I am unaware of?
Will I get extra charges?

transfer_into_account.meaning: How to transfer or add money into their own account; which ways they can add money to their account.
examples: My money is all gone. What ways are okay to add money to my account?

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.meaning: They sent/transferred money (or a transaction) and it has not arrived or completed yet ('not here yet', 'taking so long to complete', recipient/friend hasn't got it), especially after days or with the account number checked.
examples: I made a transfer the day before yesterday within this country. It is still not showing up at all. I have double-checked and the account number is certainly right. I've actually type this multiple times. can you look into what is going on here?
I transferred some money but it is not here yet
Why is my transaction taking so long to complete?
I sent a transfer to a friend that needs it urgently. It has already been 2 hours and still hasn't come through to her. How long does it normally take?

transfer_timing.meaning: How long a transfer takes to arrive, when transferred money will be available.
examples: It's been a couple days how much longer do I have to wait for my transfer?

criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Trying to verify identity but it fails or they cannot complete the identity verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify their identity, what documents are needed, the identity check process.

verify_source_of_funds.meaning: Questions about the source/origin of the money in the account: where the funds come from, proving the source of funds, seeing where the available money came from.
examples: Can I see my available money?
What kind of security protects my money?

criteria.verify_top_up: Verification of a card top-up: the verification code for a top-up card, verifying a top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card is not working or being declined.

visa_or_mastercard.meaning: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing between them.
examples: I'm wanting to get a Visa card today.

why_verify_identity.meaning: Why they need to verify their identity; reasons for the identity check.
examples: Can I use my account without verifying identity?

criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal abroad got a wrong or bad exchange rate.
